channel.title: AI & Healthcare AI Daily
channel.description: A daily briefing on AI and healthcare AI, summarized by Claude.

item.title: Trump touts an AI "constitution" signed by AI leaders; OpenAI agents finish 46% of 2-4 hour tasks
item.description:
• Agents are getting more independent: OpenAI's research agents now finish nearly half of multi-hour tasks on their own
  • Washington is focusing on AI self-regulation, and attacks on Sam Altman's home raise safety concerns for AI leaders
  • Benefits transparency gets real: the Labor Department (DOL) has finalized its rule requiring PBMs to disclose fees

item.title: Claude-assisted Riemann proof claim meets a rival human draft; OpenAI tightens control of resellers
item.description:
• An Anthropic mathematician says he proved the Riemann hypothesis with Claude. Stanford quickly put out a rival all-human draft.
  • AI governance is tightening: OpenAI now controls who resells its models, and Newsom is promoting a 'kill switch' for frontier models.
  • Health AI is being judged on results: dollars per ER doctor for scribes and lives saved by early warning systems.

item.title: Jensen Huang resigns from Nvidia; Anthropic closes at $1.75T
item.description:
• Nvidia's leadership crisis: Jensen Huang has resigned as the stock falls sharply.
  • AI agents keep spreading, from Gemini on the Mac to prior-authorization pilots.
  • PBM reform moves to statehouses and Congress's 2027 agenda.

item.title: Anthropic's record $81.3B Nasdaq debut; Epic opens records to AI
item.description:
• Anthropic's record IPO opens trading at a $1.5T valuation, testing how much Wall Street wants AI.
  • The pace of frontier AI keeps climbing: Google's new Gemini 4 Neon and a reported OpenAI Millennium Prize result.
  • Healthcare AI is spreading into EHR access, prescribing and the operating room, with regulators still behind.

item.title: OpenAI ships GPT-6.2 Astra & Sol; Anthropic IPO set for Thursday
item.description:
• Frontier race heats up: OpenAI cuts prices with GPT-6.2 as Microsoft launches its own coding models
  • Anthropic prices its IPO ahead of a Thursday Nasdaq debut, while Nvidia stops selling AI chips to China
  • Healthcare AI moves toward agents, and Maryland becomes the first state to cap the price of Ozempic

item.title: California sues OpenAI over rogue agents; Isomorphic raises $5B
item.description:
• California's lawsuit against OpenAI over rogue agents makes AI safety a legal liability issue.
  • Washington tightens AI rules: limits on remote chip access for China, a clinical AI roadmap and a DOL rule on PBM disclosures.
  • Big money and agents in health: Isomorphic raises $5B and OpenAI adds computer-use agents for care teams.

item.title: Democrats open Nvidia probe; AMA seeks AI liability shield for doctors
item.description:
• Fallout from the Nvidia scandal is now political, with a second congressional probe into its China sales.
  • AI labs are moving into security work: OpenAI launched its Daybreak tools and Anthropic grew its Microsoft cloud deal.
  • Health AI is spreading through large systems and payers, while the AMA wants legal protection for doctors who decline to use it.

item.title: Jensen Huang resigns from Nvidia; DOL finalizes PBM transparency rule
item.description:
• Nvidia is in turmoil: Jensen Huang has resigned as CEO, and CFO Colette Kress is stepping in as interim CEO.
  • Pressure on frontier AI keeps building, from a lawsuit seeking to halt development to new questions about AI-driven care costs.
  • Rules for drug middlemen are tightening as DOL finalizes PBM fee disclosure and Florida fines 13 PBMs.

item.title: Anthropic sets $1.4T IPO range; Google launches Gemini for healthcare
item.description:
• Anthropic's IPO pricing and OpenAI's $10B quarter show how big AI's money has become, and how much it is spending.
  • Google shipped on several fronts: Gemini 4 Carbon, AlphaGenome 2, AI-checked Signal code and Gemini for healthcare.
  • Healthcare AI is consolidating and adding safety checks: Oura buys Counsel for $625M and MDCalc launches a safety layer for clinical AI.
